prompt.generated_prompt_string: An adult fashionable and energetic woman from the supplied reference stands at the main entrance of Yiwu International Trade City, with the bustling entrance and passing crowds behind her. The supplied image visibly contains the presenter, the smart sports watch on her wrist, and the trade-city location. She passionately explains the fully functional smart sports watch with cheerful, infectious female livestream energy, brings the watch close to the camera, and makes a clearance-sale gesture. Preserve the source-supported features: heart-rate and blood-oxygen measurement, built-in GPS positioning, high-definition color screen, and long battery life. Retain the source's Chinese New Year store-clearance and price-drop dialogue without inventing additional claims. Use photorealistic high-definition rendering and lively body language.
